title: passiflora × lemicheziana
intro: Passiflora × lemicheziana, commonly known as Passionflower x Lemicheziana, is a hybrid species of Passiflora that combines the characteristics of Passiflora edulis and Passiflora caerulea. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Passiflora × lemicheziana are attributed to its ability to modulate the central nervous system, providing relief from restlessness and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its calming and sedative properties.
